ratingReasons.gameplay: Memory recovery gives clear progression and tangible supplies; combat pressured navigation. Both losses exposed my poor aim and prolonged unprotected holds; limited evidence for sustained enjoyment.
ratingReasons.presentation: Cohesive rainy industrial palette, bright relay landmark and composed title screen. Repeated simple box-shaped enemies and geometry limit perceived production depth. Title visibly says BUILD59 despite review label build60.
ratingReasons.usability: Controls and contextual messages explain actions, map freezes mission and shows routes. Recover is straightforward when actually in reach. Mouse capture unavailable required fallback and turning was approximate; repeated holds outside range consumed dangerous time.
ratingReasons.readability: Objective distances, recovered cards, health and ammo are legible. Cyan archive markers and warm danger differentiate roles, but wall/cover occlusion and large boss overlays compete with combat sightlines.
ratingReasons.AAA-readiness: Two losses and narrow coverage cannot certify a polished full experience. Full boss defeat, upload and wider interactions remain unverified.
